nodes.label: US2: AOT Compilation & Perimeter CDN Caching
nodes.norm_label: us2: aot compilation & perimeter cdn caching

nodes.label: Aspire Dashboard OTLP Integration
nodes.rationale: Runs .NET Aspire Dashboard in Docker Compose on ports 18888, 4317, 4318 for real-time visualization of traces, metrics, and structured logs.

nodes.label: k6 Stress Testing Automation
nodes.rationale: Automated load testing validating sub-500ms dynamic API budget and sub-150ms p95 ETag 304 cached catalog SLA with Docker fallback.

nodes.label: Swagger UI Dev Architecture
nodes.rationale: Swashbuckle integration with Bearer JWT restricted strictly to Development environment to expose contracts without production overhead.

nodes.label: Anti-Redundancy Logging Policy
nodes.rationale: Separates discrete event logging from continuous span durations to prevent log volume explosion and eliminate duplicate operational entries.

nodes.label: Two-Phase Compilation & Invalidation Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Asynchronous pre-rendering compiles static JSON snapshots uploaded to SeaweedFS and purges CDN edge cache to ensure instant QR loading.

nodes.label: Ahead-Of-Time Perimeter Compilation
nodes.rationale: Precomputes static perimeter snapshots uploaded to SeaweedFS/CDN to strictly honor the under 2 second mobile LCP QR budget.

nodes.label: EF Core JSONB Storage for LayoutConfig
nodes.norm_label: ef core jsonb storage for layoutconfig
nodes.rationale: Decouples visual coordinates from transactional catalog tables and stores geometry inside PostgreSQL jsonb using EF Core ToJson().

nodes.label: Multi-Tenant Partitioning Strategy
nodes.rationale: Shared database with shared schema using TenantId discriminator and EF Core global query filters chosen over database-per-tenant or schema-per-tenant for connection pool efficiency and instant onboarding.

nodes.label: Tenant Resolution Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Tenant resolved via custom domain or subdomain slug in middleware, caching metadata in Redis with 10-minute sliding TTL to preserve sub-500ms budget.

nodes.label: Pre-Signed URL Generation in .NET 10
nodes.rationale: Use AWSSDK.S3 targeting SeaweedFS S3 gateway to issue temporary pre-signed PUT URLs so image binaries bypass the API process.

nodes.label: SeaweedFS Container Topology Decision
nodes.rationale: Run chrislusf/seaweedfs:latest in server -s3 -filer mode in Docker Compose for master, volume, filer, and S3 gateway in one lightweight container (ports 8888, 8333, 9333).

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry Logging Integration
nodes.rationale: Microsoft.Extensions.Logging integrated with OpenTelemetry provider extracts W3C trace context natively without custom wrapper bloat.

nodes.label: PII and Credential Redaction Strategy
nodes.rationale: Redacts credentials, tokens, and payment data prior to telemetry serialization to comply with security requirements.

nodes.label: Adaptive Telemetry Sampling Strategy
nodes.rationale: 100% sampling for errors and slow spans over 500ms, while applying head/tail sampling for frequent health check probes.
